_note: Remaster-only vertical baseline correction, authored by coat / solar with web-lv/tools/font.html. Sign convention: POSITIVE MOVES A GLYPH DOWN (kernel.js does y0 = kern + y, screen y grows downward). threestate's original table (a,g=-4; e=-1; c,h,i=-2; k,p,x,z=+2) was right for the ten glyphs it covered but left the other 28 at zero, which is why baselines wander. ?quality=original keeps the original.
